comments.author: Moriel
comments.body:
K a little bit of a correction, at least from my experiences.

I found the indicated spot and fought for several hours, and a 3 Vaisseau "bounty hunter" fleet appeared. I ambushed them, used request convoy to cause a distraction, and plundered all 3, and got nothing.

Kept it up and another "bounty hunter" fleet shows up, but this time is a fleet of 2 Vaisseau and 1 other ship(Carrack or galleon i think). I Used the same strategy, and i DID get a custom haul rope from the lead ship Vaisseau(A). This lead me to believe that there might be 2 different bounty hunter fleets that spawn, and im not sure if both can drop the rope

So i can 100% confirm the information posted above, and the skills i used was ambush, seize cargo, and plunder rank 2. The weakly ships were easy kills so you just need a little patience.
